review: Ay, mira. Fifteen women in my apartment every Wednesday and I move the furniture for it. "Las Oraciones Cruzan el Mar" — the prayers cross the sea. Nine of my fifteen have a mother in another country and three of them have a child there, and when I played this the room went completely silent, which with these women has happened maybe twice in four years. I came here at nine years old and I was the family's translator at every appointment including the bad ones, and I have never once prayed out loud in English without my voice shaking. In Spanish I can pray for an hour. This album knows about that and I do not know how.
